headline:
خطة Forza Horizon 6:
أول إضافة في يناير
label: تقرير

angle.hook: Forza Horizon 6 gets its first expansion in January 2027, and Playground Games has now laid out the seasonal updates leading up to it
angle.why_now: Pure Xbox reported the roadmap on 13 Nov, five hours before the Reel, from a Playground Games video; no Arabic outlet has carried it yet
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf players can buy the game on Steam at 269 AED in the UAE and 269 SR in Saudi Arabia, though Arabic is not among its supported languages
angle.payoff: the expansion is the headline but the studio has shared no details, so only the Series 8, 9 and 10 names and months are confirmed by the report
